claims.assertion: Athena describes Taygetan crystal-core zero-point reactors as 12 nested toroidal layers of synthetic quartz particles, with AI-controlled gravity and frequency generators regulating output through density and rotation.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says reactor size varies by vessel and function.

claims.assertion: The article describes plasma turbines with counter-rotating layers; newer versions use AI-controlled polymorphic metal to create rotation without moving parts and can generate thrust or a vessel-wrapping field.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: The plasma-jet mode produces thrust; the wrapped-field mode enables frequency jumps.
